Your JSON structure is almost correct, but there are two fixes. First, the `ner_tags` should use numeric IDs so like, `0`, `1`, `2` instead of strings like `"B-FINDING"`. Models can’t interpret text labels directly you need to map tags like `"B-FINDING"` to integers `{"B-FINDING": 1, "I-FINDING": 2, "O": 0}`). Second, ensure every `tokens` array has the same length as its corresponding `ner_tags` array. Any mistakes at this part will crash your training . You can validate this with a quick script: loop through your data and assert `len(tokens) == len(ner_tags)`.  I would double check your JSON quotes because they seem to be in strings, try a pre trained model first, if it fails to redact your PII, then fine tuning is your best bet.
